class: a selection too long for one bounded invocation, run whole under the long bound, or batched by hand outside the engine with nothing recorded
caught_by: select.batch_files: a selection longer than it runs as contiguous slices of the sorted list, each its own invocation with its own log and report under bound_minutes, never doubled by retry-2x. Only finished slices contribute suites; a slice that times out keeps its partial counts and makes the tier not-run (timeout) naming the batch, unless a red suite already failed it. A merged fail records the finished slices' files, and a merged pass what it was asked, so a whole_on pass is a whole pass the next whole_on run reuses. In tier mode, select reads the batches as scope and passes
missed_by: a selection past max that silently took the whole-run bound, so the operator's limit on minutes per invocation held only where a role ran the tier outside the engine in batches of its own
